description: Update an existing group, and optionally add animals to it. Membership is additive: animal_ids adds those animals and never removes existing members. Omit animal_ids (or pass an empty array) to leave membership unchanged. Every requested animal must be an active animal on the same farm; any unknown, archived or other-farm animal fails the whole update. A group update that adds animals cannot be undone.

animal_ids.description: Animal UUIDs to ADD to the group (additive; existing members are preserved). Omit or pass [] to leave membership unchanged. Cannot be undone.

description.description: The new description of the group.

farm_id.description: The ID of the farm (optional if a default is set).

group_id.description: The UUID of the group to update.

name.description: The new name of the group.

name: update_group
title: Update group
